excluded_ids.sub-HUP165: no annotated presurgical seizure (0 task-ictal runs) - protocol inclusion requires >=1

eligibility_rule: StudyProtocol A0001 case inclusion: at least one annotated presurgical seizure (task-ictal run with events.tsv 'sz onset'). 57 subjects in release; sub-HUP165 has 0 ictal runs -> ineligible for modeling. sub-HUP132 appears in participants.tsv but has no recordings in v1.1.3 (removed at 1.1.0) -> not a release subject. sub-HUP158 is eligible (1 ictal run) but has no interictal run (limitation, recorded). R2 signal/anatomy QC per case is still pending; a case failing QC is excluded later without re-splitting (it keeps its partition).

variables: intervention class (participants.tsv 'therapy': ABLATION/RESECTION; no RNS rows present in v1.1.3)
implant type (participants.tsv 'implant' SEEG/ECOG; agrees with acq- file label for 57/57)
stratification.method: within each therapy x implant stratum: floor(0.6 n) to development, remaining development slots (to reach round(0.6*56)=34) by largest fractional remainder (seeded tie-break); members shuffled with random.Random(seed) after sorting ids

cohort_families.site: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania (HUP)
cohort_families.overlap_notes: Same patients may appear in other HUP-derived resources: Kini & Bernabei 2019 / EpiVR subset (A0034; e.g. HUP080), Bernabei 2022 subset, Omni-iEEG 'hup' subset (re-packages ds004100, A0040), and HUP-labelled subjects in the fragility multicenter collection (ds003029, A0035) per A0066/A0070. None of these may be pooled as independent cohorts or used as external test data for this split; any future addition must map subject ids across sources first and keep each patient in the partition assigned here.

development.use: model building, hypothesis selection, fitting, tuning

test.use: held out; predictions frozen before R5 outcome_evaluation

partitions.within_patient: all runs (ictal and interictal) of a patient stay in that patient's partition; seizure-level sub-partitions, if needed, are defined inside a ModelBundle using presurgical data only

label_access_policy: outcomes sealed in vault; only R5 outcome_evaluation after prediction freeze
label_access_details: Outcome columns ('outcome', 'engel') were separated into work/T0015/outcomes_to_seal.json for the lead to seal; no outcome value appears in this artifact. Raw data/ds004100-1.1.3/participants.tsv still contains them and must be access-restricted (not read by modeling roles). Split and case selection used only non-outcome linkage (therapy, implant) and sidecar counts.
leakage_controls: patient-level; disjoint id sets asserted; no outcome used; split_hash immutable
split_hash_definition: sha256 of json.dumps({'development_ids': sorted, 'test_ids': sorted}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
